اشتعلتما (form VIII)
# اِشْتَعَلْتُمَا (ištaʕaltumā) /iʃ.ta.ʕal.tu.maː/: second-person dual past active of اِشْتَعَلَ (ištaʕala)
# اُشْتُعِلْتُمَا (uštuʕiltumā) /uʃ.tu.ʕil.tu.maː/: second-person dual past passive of اِشْتَعَلَ (ištaʕala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
